records.key: Stop the moving background — useful while looking at images. It gives its threads back rather than only hiding.
records.source: Stop the moving background — useful while looking at images. It gives its threads back rather than only hiding.
records.translation: गतिशील पृष्ठभूमि रोकें — छवियों को देखते समय उपयोगी। यह केवल छिपने के बजाय अपने थ्रेड छोड़ देती है।
